project.name: Docs A Stranger Can Follow
project.goal: Write a quickstart for THE PYTHON `httpx` LIBRARY that takes a competent developer who has never used it from nothing to a working, verified result in under ten minutes. Replace the subject with the tool I care about first — it can be a public project or one of mine in this workspace. Every command in the quickstart must be one you have actually run in this project's workspace and seen work; quote the real output, never a plausible one. Cover the first thing that goes wrong for a newcomer and how to tell it apart from the second thing. No step may say 'configure as appropriate'. It is finished when the whole quickstart runs top to bottom in a clean directory, in one go, and the script that proves that is part of the deliverable.
